title: Instrument mesh pipeline/descriptor selection per-frame (throttled)
purpose: Verify that ext-only is used before shell readiness and that descriptor pushes match selected pipeline.

steps.detail: In MeshParticleRenderer::render, print '[PIPELINE DEBUG] pipeline=ext|ext+shell descriptors=2|3 shellReady=0|1' every ~120 frames.
Assert that when pipeline=ext, no binding 4 write is pushed.

acceptance: Logs show correct pipeline selection and descriptor count
